transcript.text: Hello! How can I help you with Massachusetts RMV services today?
¿Qué documentos necesito para obtener REAL ID en Massachusetts?

To get a REAL ID in Massachusetts, you'll need one document proving your identity and lawful presence, like a valid U.S. passport or certified birth certificate. You also need one document showing your Social Security number and two documents proving Massachusetts residency dated within the last 60 days.
